4159.title: Mutable plugin ESM generations remain retained
4159.rootCauseOneLine: Generation-stamped native ESM URLs retain previous module state even after mutable-root deregistration.
4159.proposedFix: Design unloadable server-plugin execution with explicit lifecycle and SDK transport semantics.
4159.caveats: Isolated extracted loader tested twice on Node 22; reported TypeScript amplification, full service cycles, and Electron crash remain unverified.
